bullets.text: In a supervised individual study, wrote Python functions to parse provided research abstract records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, joined research abstract identifiers to provided metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.

As an individual contribution to a supervised four-student project, wrote Python functions to parse provided product review records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, ranked product review documents for provided queries using TF-IDF similarity in scikit-learn and checked retrieved documents against a small judged query set.

Under supervision, joined product review document identifiers to metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
As an individual contributor within a supervised research team, wrote Python functions to parse provided news summary records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, joined news summary document identifiers to provided metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
